# SaaS Spend Track

> Browser-only SaaS spend and contract management for 20-500 person teams. Flat $3,499/year, 250 active contracts included. No seat pricing. No per-vendor pricing. No data ever leaves the user's browser.

SaaS Spend Track is built by Whizzlead Solutions OPC Private Limited (Bengaluru, India), led by founder Vinay Raghavendran (13+ years in B2B SaaS RevOps, former Whatfix, Proshort, LatentView Analytics). The tool runs entirely client-side; there is no backend server receiving customer contract or spend data. That architecture is the deliberate choice behind the pricing — no per-seat SaaS infrastructure to amortize.

## What the tool does

- Parse uploaded contracts (PDF, DOCX, pasted text) and extract renewal date, notice period, auto-renew clause, price cap, term length
- Track monthly and annualized spend across every vendor
- Score each contract across 8 risk dimensions (auto-renew exposure, orphan ownership, usage waste, overlap, shadow SaaS, contractual gaps, concentration risk, renewal timing)
- Surface renewals due in the next 90 days with notice-period windows highlighted
- Forecast 12-month licence spend based on usage trends
- Ask natural-language questions against the contract corpus ("what renews next month", "which vendors have 90-day notice")
- Bulk-import existing vendor spreadsheets (CSV, 60+ header aliases auto-detected)
- Export monthly spend summary PDF, renewal roster CSV, and savings opportunities PDF
- Multi-currency display (USD, INR, EUR, GBP, AUD, SGD, AED, JPY, CAD) with live FX

## How it is different from Vendr, Zylo, Spendesk, BetterCloud, Productiv, Zluri

- Browser-only: zero data leaves the user's device, zero backend to breach
- Flat annual pricing: $3,499/year regardless of team size or vendor count (vs $12k-50k+ for named competitors)
- No seat pricing, no procurement-services markup, no per-vendor fees
- Deploy time: sign up to first dashboard is under 10 minutes vs 4-12 weeks for enterprise SMPs
- Target customer: 20-500 person company that currently uses a spreadsheet and has outgrown it
- Not for: 2000+ person enterprises that need SAML SSO, SOC 2 Type II, API-first integration into ERP

## Who it is for

- Finance teams at Series A-C startups who run SaaS spend out of Google Sheets today
- Procurement leads at 50-500 person companies tracking 20-100 active vendor contracts
- CFOs at profitable bootstrapped companies who want enterprise-grade visibility without enterprise-grade SaaS cost
- Indian and APAC mid-market companies priced out of $50k/year US-built SMPs

## Pricing

- $3,499/year for the full tool, every feature, unlimited users on the same workspace
- Includes 250 active contracts
- $100/year per 50 additional contracts above 250
- Indian customers: 18% GST added at checkout; international customers: no GST (LUT filed for FY 2026-27)
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required
